Revenue Systems Brief

One useful idea. One system to improve.

A concise field note for people responsible for revenue, operations and growth.

Subscribe on LinkedIn

01 / The problem

Revenue breaks between functions, not inside them.

Marketing can generate demand. Sales can close. Customer teams can retain. Yet revenue still leaks when the hand-offs, definitions and data between them do not form a coherent system.

01

Disconnected strategy

Teams optimise local targets without a shared commercial direction.

02

Unclear process

Critical decisions depend on memory, heroics and inconsistent hand-offs.

03

Untrusted data

Reports describe activity, but rarely explain what should happen next.

04

Tool-led change

Technology is added before the operating model is ready to support it.
